Fonts used by the UI, self-hosted so the demo works offline.

- Fraunces (variable: opsz, wght, SOFT), Undercase Type, SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Instrument Sans (variable wght), Instrument, SIL Open Font License 1.1

Latin subset only, downloaded from Google Fonts. `fonts.css` holds the @font-face rules and is imported by `css/app.css`.
